lines.arrive: A cave. All your life, you've faced this wall.
lines.shadows: Shapes pass by. The others name them, and guess what comes next.
lines.turn: Behind you, a fire. People carrying cutouts. The shadows were only this.
lines.climb: A path leads up, towards a light.
lines.bright: It's too bright to look at.
lines.choose: You could stay up here. Or go back down, and tell them.
lines.back_dark: Down here, you can barely see anymore.
lines.tell: They laugh. The climb has ruined your eyes, they say. Nobody else will go.
lines.stay_end: You stay in the light. The others are still down there, and you're the only one who knows the way.
lines.watch_end: You turn back to the wall. The shapes are familiar. It's easier.
lines.reflection: Your reflection. Another kind of shadow, but this one looks back.
lines.behind: The firelight flickers. Among the shapes on the wall, a new one. It moves when you move.
lines.hurts: It hurts to look. The wall was easier.
lines.outside_1: Outside. It's too bright. You can't make anything out yet.
lines.outside_2: The real things. And the sun that lights them all.
lines.horse: It's much bigger than its shadow.
